description: This file defines the RpcEndpointRef class, which provides an interface for remote RPC endpoint references in Apache Spark, including methods for sending messages and handling asynchronous replies.

classes.name: RpcEndpointRef
classes.description: An abstract class representing a reference to a remote RpcEndpoint, providing methods for message passing and reply handling.

classes.name: AbortableRpcFuture
classes.description: A wrapper for Future that adds an abort method to allow cancelling long-running RPC calls.

methods.name: askAbortable
methods.description: Sends a message and returns an AbortableRpcFuture to receive the reply, with support for aborting the RPC.

methods.name: ask
methods.description: Sends a message and returns a Future for the reply, with a default timeout.

methods.name: askSync
methods.description: Sends a message and blocks until the reply is received or timeout occurs.
